comment: Baseline: parse and re-emit only. No compression, no mangling. extendscript:true is already active here because re-emitting source containing nested ternary expressions without parentheses is itself unsafe (Illustrator parser bug 'Error 25: Expected: :.'). keep_quoted_props/quote_keys are mandatory: unquoted reserved-word keys ('{if:2}') raise 'Error 9: Illegal use of reserved word' in ExtendScript.
